h: Boats, beaches and a ride along the valley
p: The Quay in East Looe is where the fishing fleet ties up and the pleasure boats tout for trade, so Carousel is a handy stop while you're waiting for your boat trip or letting your chips go down. Boats run from the harbour out towards Looe Island, the little nature reserve just offshore, plus fishing trips and coastal cruises in season.

If you've come by car, a day out on the Looe Valley Line is a lovely alternative: the little branch train winds up the river to Liskeard. Polperro, the picture-perfect fishing village, is only a few miles along the coast, though the lanes are narrow, so many people park and walk in.
